About Flourish

An experience for women longing
to tend to who they are becoming

Flourish is an intimate retreat experience for women who are longing for space to slow down, reconnect with themselves, and tend to who they are becoming.

Set just outside of Charlotte, North Carolina, Flourish creates space to breathe deeply, be cared for well, and remember that growth takes time.

Each retreat is led by women who have previously participated in Flourish and returned to pour back into others through leadership, encouragement, and community.

The experience moves through four meaningful themes:

🌱 Rooted 🌿 Tending 🌸 Becoming ✨ Flourish

Each theme invites movement, growth, and transformation.

This is not a conference schedule packed from morning to night.
There is room to breathe here.

Women often come unsure if they belong.
They leave feeling rooted, seen, confident, and connected.

Flourish is not simply a retreat.
It is a space where women are nurtured while becoming.

Your Retreat Host

Wanda Velez

Wanda Velez is an educator, speaker, leadership coach, and founder of Flourish Retreats.

After spending over 30 years mentoring students, developing leaders, and walking alongside women through seasons of transition and growth, Wanda created Flourish as a space where women could pause, reflect, heal, and reconnect with who they are becoming.

She is passionate about helping women live with intention, resilience, faith, and courage — while creating spaces where women feel seen, supported, and deeply cared for.

Retreat Speakers

Women bringing wisdom,
healing, and truth

Akinlana Burrowes
Licensed Mental Health Counselor · Expressive Arts Therapist

Akinlana is a licensed mental health counselor and expressive arts therapist based in Charlotte, NC. A former missionary in East Africa, she specializes in trauma healing for communities of African descent. She leads Karibuni Counseling & Wellness and founded Triumph Over Trauma Healing International, blending faith, creativity, and culturally rooted care.

Julie Babalola
Licensed Clinical Social Worker · 20+ Years Experience

Julie is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with over 20 years of experience supporting women and families through life's transitions. She focuses on trauma-informed therapy and crisis support, blending faith and evidence-based practices to foster healing. Julie is passionate about helping women build emotional resilience, spiritual wholeness, and meaningful connection.

Retreat Leaders

Women who have flourished
and returned to pour back in

Michele Blanck

A retired educator with 35 years in higher education and 45 years of ministry, Michele leads with compassion and conviction, believing God continues to grow and bloom us as we stay rooted in Him.

Jennifer Ezeigwe

A connector at heart who finds joy in uplifting others and helping her community thrive. A devoted mother of three, she creates spaces that inspire, refresh, and reflect the love of Christ.

Larreya Schmidt

A stay-at-home mom of two toddlers rooted in faith, passionate about whole-person health and Christ-centered community. Her heart is to create spaces where women feel seen, heard, and encouraged.
